fact: The director of statistics and census at the Ministry of Planning, Nabil al-Qanqa, said exceptional conditions have prevented a population census since 2006, with repeated postponements through 2022, and that divided institutions still block accurate population data.
title: القانقا: الظروف التي مرت بها ليبيا حالت دون تنفيذ التعداد السكاني منذ 2006
